verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance page mentions native connectors and scheduled imports, so recurring refresh is documented in passing. Nothing in the evidence shows per-source last-sync status or a documented post-close refresh cadence. missing for 10: per-connection last-synced timestamp/status display, documentation of schedule configuration (frequency, timing relative to close), connector-level sync monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a finance lead, each connected source shows when it last synced, and data refreshes on a documented schedule after the close

citations.quote: easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
